# netbox_tags (Data Source)

Lists NetBox tag objects (`/api/extras/tags/`) matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_tags" "all" {}

data "netbox_tags" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "q", value = "example" },
  ]
  limit = 10
}

output "tags_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_tags.filtered.items[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/extras/tags/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of objects to return (default: all).

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The matching objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.


<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `color` (String) Color. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `object_types` (Set of String) Object Types. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `slug` (String) Slug.
- `tagged_items` (Number) Tagged Items.
- `url` (String) Url.
- `weight` (Number) Weight. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
